items.title: This can only mean one thing...DFN2019
items.text: This can only mean one thing...DFN2019

We got there pretty early and I did not find an exclusive vinyl. Here’s a photo of his black shirt I picked up. 


[Aphex Twin Ceremonia shirt Black ](https://imgur.com/gallery/pA0Z54g)
Daylight savings time happened during his set so on the clock it looked like he played from 1:20 to 3:50 but it was only an hour and a half
What about adding Massive Attack to possible? Their rescheduled tour ends in late September with no Texas tour dates. Just saw them in Mexico and it was a fantastic show

Bob Moses is playing Coachella, Governors Ball, Firefly, EF, has no dates past Oct 3, and no Texas dates. Lolla was pretty sure they were gonna get them but they didn’t so maybe that means C3 has interest?

items.text: BMSR Two Nights
[hmmm, I guess I'd buy a ticket :)](https://imgur.com/f5nbGd1)
I got to dissolve with him in Mexico. Hope you had an absolute blast but I can't imagine you didn't!
Hell yeah. He played way more afx then I expected in MX and I think he still only played 4-5 of his own tracks
Absolutely brother! Aphex Twin creates these incredible experiences and anytime you get to be there for it is absolutely mind blowing
It sounds like she’s never been to a rave ever with her criticisms

I would say Trilogy. I got into NIN very late and the trilogy is one of my favorite things ever. Ghosts honestly is a close second lol. No disrespect to The Fragile or Downward Spiral, both are incredible

items.title: Anastasia in Mexico?
items.text:
Anastasia in Mexico?
I didn’t think I saw anyone else on stage with Richard in Mexico, but I’m not sure. She was obviously at Coachella and Brooklyn. I didn’t think anyone else was there, but looking back at the video, it looks like she might have been there with him. Does anyone know definitely whether or not she was at his Mexico set?
Sweet. I was in a position of to center left so I couldn’t tell.
I really loved seeing him in Mexico City, the culture made it such a unique experience, and seeing him while being surrounded by trees added to it. So many amazing musicians all day too
Any thoughts on moving Anderson Paak to likely/logical? He’s skipping Austin while Mac DeMarco and Thundercat aren’t. Also what about adding Massive Attack and Bob Moses to Possible?
They're definitely out unfortunately!

Helllllll yeah. I heard someone describe the difference between Autechre and Aphex is that Richard never left his dancey rave vibes. He was pretty stoic at DFN but he was grooving at ceremonia as well

One quick thought. There’s a question that said “do you try to recycle waste at festivals”

I took this as “do I recycle things that are recyclable” but I hesitated. I thought it might also be asking if I try to recycle trash. I think that’s a bit of a stretch but it still caused me to hesitate

I probably wouldn’t say “recycle waste” that makes me think that maybe that means I’m trying to recycle something that should be going in the trash. I may be alone in this thought lol. I would just say “do you try to recycle if there is a proper bin for it” obviously a little more technical than that lol
No problem! Thank you!
I will give away every organ in my body if Richard is on the lineup
Papadosio also has cubes like this
The DFN set was not a live DJ set to my knowledge. Day For Night specifically said it wasn't, and it didn't appear to be at the set.

Without reading anything concrete, I’m skeptical. I saw the guy getting compressions and that was quite scary. 4 deaths though? That’s huge. 3 died at Lost Lands last year and it was a huge deal, and that’s a 3-day fest. Anybody have anything more concrete
Damn...do you have any links?
I got in late day 1 and the person receiving CPR was like the first thing I saw on getting into the venue. Very sad
Horrible. That's so sad. Seemed like everybody I met was having a great time so it's horrible to see that

Also they just kinda are assholes. I saw them open for Cherub at Vulcan Gas Co 4 years ago and they were just so annoying. They barely did anything music wise, kept screaming into the mic and spitting water onto the crowd and yelling shit like “FUCK THE MUSIC INDUSTRY” “WE WERE HOMELESS A YEAR AGO” and the crowd did not match their energy.
